note: Contract set 1.3 (2026-09-29, ADR-008). Every host, secretRef name and value is synthetic; no example carries a credential value (inline-password.json holds a labelled placeholder to prove the field is refused). Expected-failure pairs are PREDICTED by the architect, who has no shell, and UNMEASURED until `contracts/validate.py --emit-expectations` is run: see contracts/CHANGELOG.md 2026-09-29.

valid.note: Production shape: three brokers, SASL_SSL with SCRAM-SHA-512, the receiver principal's credentials and a private CA, both by secretRef
SSL with a client certificate: the principal is the certificate named by security.secretRef (tls.crt, tls.key); tls.secretRef is the CA only
PLAINTEXT to a loopback broker only: a testcontainers Kafka mapped to 127.0.0.1, or a developer's local broker. Never carries real data
The Compose lite stack after ADR-008 D5: SASL_SSL to the broker's internal listener on the Compose network, with a per-component SCRAM user and a dev CA generated at `up`

invalid.violates: PLAINTEXT only when every bootstrap server is loopback; a Compose service name is a network hop, not loopback. This is exactly the lite stack's pre-ADR-008 configuration, which e3ddee1 refuses at runtime
invalid.expectation_note: PREDICTED (set 1.3), UNMEASURED. Same mechanism as channel-spec source-kafka-plaintext-remote.json, which measured at the item with pattern

invalid.violates: an SSL engine connection must present a client certificate (security.secretRef): without one the broker sees no principal, and the per-component ACLs of topics/v0 3.4 cannot apply
saslMechanism is SCRAM-SHA-512 in v0; PLAIN sends the password itself to the broker and is refused (topics/v0 3.4)
no field can carry a credential value; credentials come only through security.secretRef. The value is a labelled synthetic placeholder
broker certificate and hostname verification cannot be turned off; there is no field for it, so an 'insecure' switch is an unknown property

no librdkafka property passthrough: a free-form map merged into the client config can override acks=all and enable.idempotence (invariant 1). Contract-owned client settings come from topics/v0 topic-defaults.json only
invalid.expectation_note: PREDICTED (set 1.3), UNMEASURED. First root-level pair in these contracts; if jsonschema reports the root path differently, correct the path, not the rule

invalid.violates: PLAINTEXT carries no secretRef or tls: a SCRAM password or certificate sent to a plaintext listener is a configuration mistake, never a feature
